title: selinum bulbosum
intro: Selinum bulbosum, commonly known as Wild Celery, is a perennial plant native to Europe and Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic effects, which can aid in soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Wild Celery include its analgesic and expectorant properties, making it useful in relieving pain and reducing congestion. The bioactive constituents of Wild Celery include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
